title: 22.5 A 0.3pJ/b 32Gb/s/Pin Single-Ended PAM-4 Receiver with a Delay-Less Capacitive-Feedback Equalizer
problem: Multi-level signaling (PAM4) increases data throughput for memory and I/O interfaces but reduces SNR, requiring complex equalization that increases power consumption and area. Traditional equalization circuits introduce delay and complexity.
motivation: Memory bandwidth demands continue to grow; PAM4 signaling is essential to meet throughput targets, but equalization overhead threatens power budgets and die area efficiency.
method: A delay-less capacitive-feedback equalizer (CFE) performs PAM4 signal equalization without introducing pipeline delay. The receiver is implemented in 28nm CMOS, enabling a simple, power-efficient equalization structure that directly compensates for channel ISI.
key_novelty: Delay-less capacitive-feedback equalizer architecture enabling low-power PAM4 reception without sacrificing latency.
contributions: Energy efficiency of 0.3pJ/b at 32Gb/s/pin PAM4 reception
Compact active area of 0.00288mm² in 28nm CMOS
Simplified circuit eliminating traditional DFE or feed-forward equalizer overhead
primary_theme: Low-power delay-less PAM4 receiver for high-speed memory interfaces
